decision: Access is granted by job function, not by resource type — new resource types never require a new role.
why: Without job-function scoping, every new allowed resource type forces team re-onboarding.

links.note: Joining the platform creates the Entra ID group that scopes engineer access — roles target the group.
Reader on the 'Subscription Bank' is what allows engineers to discover subscriptions available for reuse.
The wildcard violation holds only because break-glass names the single sanctioned exception.

violations: Custom role with wildcard write permissions.
